short_text: LO Pump A low pressure + abnormal noise; standby required
description: Intermittent low lube oil pressure alarms on C-201 with LO Pump A running. Grinding noise from pump. Started ~08:40. Local LO pressure fluctuated 220–310 kPa (normal ~350). Switched to LO Pump B at 09:05; pressure stabilized ~355 kPa and noise ceased. No external leaks observed.
